description: This PHP source file defines the CookieJar class in the Guzzle HTTP client library, responsible for storing, managing, and handling cookies within HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: Class that manages a collection of cookies, providing methods to add, retrieve, clear, and serialize cookies, as well as extract cookies from HTTP responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the CookieJar with strict mode and optional initial cookies array.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar instance from an associative array of cookies and a domain.

methods.name: shouldPersist
methods.description: Determines whether a cookie should be persisted based on its expiry and discard flags.

methods.name: getCookieByName
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie by its name.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the cookies in the jar to an array.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears cookies based on domain, path, and name filters.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar after validation and conflict resolution.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of cookies stored.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the stored cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from HTTP response headers and stores them in the jar.

methods.name: getCookiePathFromRequest
methods.description: Calculates the cookie path based on the request URI following RFC 6265.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Adds appropriate Cookie headers to an outgoing request based on stored cookies.

methods.name: removeCookieIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a cookie from the jar if its value is null or empty.
